scripts.dev:web: sh -c 'token=$(bun -e "console.log(crypto.randomUUID())"); MAGIC_CONTEXT_DASHBOARD_TOKEN=$token bun run server:web & server_pid=$!; trap "kill $server_pid" EXIT INT TERM; VITE_MAGIC_CONTEXT_DASHBOARD_TOKEN=$token bun run dev:frontend'
scripts.serve:web: sh -c 'bun run build && bun run server:web'
scripts.serve:web:all: sh -c 'bun run build && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin webserver --no-default-features --features webserver && bun run server:web'
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run build
